attempts.summary: Deployed a 3-member MariaDB Galera cluster (MariaDB 10.11 + galera 26.4) across node1/node2/node3 on RHEL 10, seeded application data (appdb.orders), performed a full cluster maintenance-window shutdown and clean restart with all committed writes preserved and all three members serving again, then performed the mandatory sequential OS-level restart of each node (one at a time, preserving quorum) with proven boot-identity changes and post-restart cluster/data verification for every node.
